passkeyProtected.title: Passkey Protected
passkeyProtected.body: Your recovery phrase is derived from your passkey. To restore on another device, use your passkey or the recovery phrase below.

passkeyUnavailable.title: Passkey Unavailable
passkeyUnavailable.body: Your recovery phrase is derived from your passkey. Without it, the phrase cannot be retrieved on this device. Sign in on a device where the passkey is still available to view it.

notFound.title: No Backup Found
notFound.body: Could not find a recovery phrase on this device.

reveal.title: Tap to reveal phrase
reveal.hintRevealed: Make sure no one is watching

logout.confirmPasskey: Logging out deletes all Glow data stored on this device. You'll need your passkey to access your funds again.
logout.confirmMnemonic: Logging out deletes all Glow data stored on this device. Make sure you've saved your recovery phrase: you'll need it to access your funds again.

pinReset.bodyPasskey: The PIN can't be recovered. The only way back in is to erase all Glow data on this device and sign in again with your passkey.
pinReset.bodyMnemonic: The PIN can't be recovered. The only way back in is to erase all Glow data on this device and restore from your recovery phrase. Make sure you have it saved.

stableBalance.toUsd: Your BTC balance will be converted to USD.
stableBalance.toBtc: Your USD balance will be converted back to BTC.
stableBalance.disclaimerBody: Your balance is held in USD. Incoming BTC is automatically converted to USD, and outgoing payments are converted back to BTC. Amounts under the conversion threshold remain as change until they accumulate.

generate.body: Write down these words in order. This is your only backup to recover your funds.
generate.warning: Never share your recovery phrase. Anyone with these words can access your funds.
